entities.name: PMID:25084021
observations: 2014 study of 54 resected pancreatic IPMN specimens (181 lesions); immunohistochemistry and RNA analysis examined EZH2, Ki-67, and p27Kip1.

entities.name: EZH2
observations: In resected IPMN lesions, expression increased with grade and was higher in carcinoma in situ/invasive carcinoma than adenoma/borderline lesions; correlated positively with Ki-67 (p<0.0001).

entities.name: p27Kip1 (CDKN1B)
observations: In the 2014 IPMN study, malignant lesions had lower p27Kip1 mRNA than benign lesions (p<0.05); EZH2-positive malignant cells did not express p27Kip1, and transcript levels inversely correlated (p=0.0109).

entities.name: Pancreatic IPMN
observations: The study analyzed 181 lesions from 54 surgically resected IPMN specimens across normal duct, adenoma, borderline atypia, carcinoma in situ, and invasive carcinoma categories.

entities.name: EZH2-p27 association in IPMN
observations: In an observational study of resected IPMN lesions, EZH2 rose while p27Kip1 fell with malignant grade; EZH2 and p27Kip1 mRNA were inversely correlated (p=0.0109). The study supports association, not causal proof by EZH2 perturbation.
